body: Android's redeem now extracts the first https URL (preferring one with /invite/) from pasted text and trims trailing punctuation, so 'Join my list: https://…/invite/T.' works. The web's redeem page accepts a full URL or a bare token (T-71) but not surrounding text. Mirror the extraction in web/src (a small pure function with the same cases as Android's pastedInvite; consider a shared-test-cases table) so both clients behave the same.
title: Web: a pasted invite message with text around the link should still redeem (Android does since T-300)
